book.name: Efesas
book.title: Poldi Efesas Habu Yengele Hibi Kwelengkewec

content: Esecne sowacneholec gaibeng
Ngenge esecne Wapongte yefe ewalilu bikickolec galu homaicne ailu,
himongte gagawa nga aleng yengele ngictau tapiliineholec balaibeibong. Ailu yakumac yowa wewe ngic gagaing, yengele ngictau yogolec bole balu gagaing.
Ngenge nga nonge momochac nongileng esecne yengele alingka galu socnonggengte gagale angac nga ngage-ngage sasawa balaibelu gaibeng. Aime nongileng yenge ingucne Wapongte aalicti feinonggang fewec.
Wapongti bagboliyecnubalu ngage-ngagesingka locnubawec

Nongileng Wapongte yefe ewalilu gabeng asunonggeng homaicne gaibeng. Aime Wapongti sifu kwele-sowac sugucnehac ainolelu kwele-angactowa ngagenolewecte nongileng momoc Kristoholec bacnubalu bagboliyecnubawec. Aime Wapongti kwele-madic aingelewec, yogodi bikicte ameine bame wasecne aidaingte.
Ye Kristo Yesule madicnele ailu kwele-madic ailu yeholec taocnubawec. Yogolec dameng lobewa fikeme baba-madictowaine mime yegengkenale Kristo Yesuholec bagboliyecnubalu honocmengka locnubawec.

I yangucte, ngenge Yesu ngagesingkeibongte yedi kwele-madic aingelewec, yogodi bikicte ameine bame wasecne aiibong. Aime Wapong ye ngageboc mi ailu ngage-ngagesingngineng yogo ngelewec, yogo ngengelacni miyac.
Wasecne aiibong, yogo ngengileng aibabale miyac. Ilec monicti yeicne ngageme wiyac feicne mi aidaic.
Nongileng Wapongte mole-hibi ailu Kristo Yesuholec wetackelu gabeng, Wapongti aibaba madicne esecnehac alingkelu milockenolewec. Ailu yedi aibaba yogo balaibelu ganangte bacnubawec.
Yesule emewa wetackelu ganoga

Ilec ngenge wiyac yago ngagebong fadaic. Ngenge esecne Israel yengele alingkacni miyac galu himong-socte alingka gaibong. Inguc gaebongka, Israel ngic yengi soc tofangineng helockeibongte ngengele yanguc miibong, “Ngenge soc tofangineng mi helockeicne ailu Wapongte alingkacni miyac.” Soc tofaine heloc-heloc yogo ngicti socka moc aiicne.

Dameng iwa ngenge Kristo mikac galu Israel ngic yengele alingka taockenogale kpatalangelebong gaibong. Aime Wapongti mimipang sanangnele yowa hefelu Israel ngic-ngigac weduyelewec, yogolec lobeina gaibong. Ngenge himong yagowa Wapong mikac gaibong, aime gaga madicne monic fikengeledaicte, yogo mi ngagelu wangec gaibong.
Ngenge esecne inguc dalicka gaibong. Ailu yanguctihac Kristo Yesuholec kpatulelu gagabiyeng. Aime Kristole sacti sotiyeme Wapongte emewa kwesilu gagabiyeng.
Yesudi ngaba baickeme aling moniyang sugu aiibeng

Kristo ye yeuctihac kwele-moniyang ainolewec. Nonge Israel ngic-ngigac nga ngenge Israel alingkacni miyac, hewacnonggang ngabadi aka fawec, yogo yedi heuckelu baickeme miyac aiwec. Ailu ye yeicneholec kpatulecnubame habu moniyang aiibeng.

Yesudi himong-socine homacka lowec, yogodi Wapongte yefe-yowale kwelina ung-yowa fagac, yogo noine mikac aiwec. Inguc aime ngenge nga nonge momochac ngic gbolicne moniyang fikebeng kwele-moniyang fikewec.

Ye habu yaeckang ngabaholec siyeckelu gaebengka malicpongka homalu domawec, yogodi nongileng kpatulecnubame ngaba miyac aime soc moniyang aiibeng. Aibeng Wapongta kpatulecnubalu locnubame yeholec kwele-moniyang aiibeng.
Yedi kwesilu ngenge dalicka nga nonge bangkacka momochac emeina ganangte kwele-moniyangte yowa madicne mime yegengkenoleme ngageibeng.
Asu moniyangti bacnubame ngenge nga nonge kpatulelu Mamacte emewa nalic hikelu domanoga.
Wapongte mac

Ilec dameng yanguctihac Israel yengele alingkacni miyac, ngenge kwilic mi gagaing. Ngenge ngic-ngigac Wapongte bingec yengeholec kpatulelu mac fileine aiibong. Ailu yanguctihac Wapongte alingfocine gagaing.

Ngenge nongeholec Wapongte mac bacngebaicne. Kristo Yesu yeuctihac posa-bosing sanangne aigac. Aime salecebaicne nga Wapongte siduc-mimi ngic yenge mac yogo bosing ingucne kwesingkelu Yesuholec domagaing.
Yele ailu nongileng sasawadi yele feiwa mac yogo taockeme taoc felu Sugucnele ibu-mac gbagbacne fikelu sugulegabeleng.
Ngenge inguchac yela basugulecngebalu taocngebame ngenge Wapongte mac fikebong Asudi kwelenginang gagac.
